prompt: This violates the Single Responsibility Principle. Why?
choices: Report has three separate responsibilities (content, persistence, delivery) — three reasons to change
generateContent() and saveToFile() should be static
The class mixes public and private methods
explanation: SRP: Report changes if the content format changes, if the file system changes, or if the email system changes. Fix: split into Report (content), ReportWriter (file I/O), and ReportMailer (email). Each class has one reason to change.
